content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: metering.token_count_drift spike in eu-prod. Multiple overage flags firing, starting ~1777774200. Investigate and triage.

sre_oncall: ack. I'm on it, pulling metrics now.

kevin_billing: seeing +18% token delta vs baseline across emitter shard eu-02 between 1777774100-1777774300. Shadow counts also bumped. Not all customers affected — looks skewed to a few heavy accounts.

jamie_prodeng: can you paste the raw sample logs? want to check if it's double-count or late-replay.

kevin_billing: snippet: ```
2024-10-11T09:10:11Z emitter=eu-02 req_id=abc123 tokens=1200 routed=true
2024-10-11T09:10:12Z emitter=eu-02 req_id=abc123 retry=true tokens=1200 routed=true
```

kevin_billing: those retry=true lines look suspicious — we might be double-emitting on retries.

ops_runbook_bot: Runbook suggest: confirm emitter retry dedupe status, check kafka-at-least-once offsets, and temporarily suppress customer overage alerts with slack flag. Steps: 1) set metric.suppress=true for alert group, 2) scale emitter consumer down/up to reset offsets.

sre_oncall: I can test dedupe flag. Running quick query to confirm distinct request ids per token batch...

maya_cs: customer-impact: two customers (acme-inc, small-ml-startup) received automated overage emails 20m ago. They're asking if charges are real. Please prioritize comms if we mitigate.

jamie_prodeng: if it's a retry double-emit we should stop incoming duplicates quickly. Proposal: flip emitter-side idempotency on eu-02 (safe toggle) and pause alerting. Command to toggle: ```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://admin.internal/v1/emitter/eu-02/toggle-idempotency --data '{"enable":true}'
```

sre_oncall: running safe toggle now. Will monitor token stream and report back in 60s.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-9473. Severity: P2. Pager duty escalation queued.

kevin_billing: while toggling, noticed emitter consumer lag is tiny but consumer commit rate showed duplicate commits around 1777774185. I'll open a quick kafka trace.

sre_oncall: toggle succeeded. observing immediate drop in duplicate req_ids in sample window. Token delta trending down.

maya_cs: thanks — I'm drafting a short message to affected customers: "we detected a metering anomaly causing duplicate token reports; we've mitigated the issue and are reconciling billing; no final charges will be applied until reconciliation completes." Want approvals?

jamie_prodeng: approve the wording. Add timeline: started 09:08 UTC, mitigation applied 09:14 UTC.

ops_runbook_bot: Suggested mitigation checklist: [x] suppress alerts, [x] enable idempotency, [ ] reconcile shadow counts, [ ] postmortem.

kevin_billing: starting backfill/reconciliation job now against shadow ledger to scrub duplicates. ETA ~45m. Will surface a reconciled delta table when done: /internal/billing/recons/INC-2024-9473.

sre_oncall: monitoring for 10m window to ensure no further drift. If stable, I'll hand over to billing for reconciliation and CS for comms.

maya_cs: I'll send the approved customer note and keep a follow-up scheduled after reconciliation.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied. Please continue with reconciliation and postmortem.

jamie_prodeng: logging here: suspected root cause = emitter retry path didn't set dedupe id on retry path due to path regression after recent refactor. Ticket created: ENG-5021.

sre_oncall: handing off to kevin_billing + maya_cs for next steps. I'll remain available if ripple reappears.

kevin_billing: noted. I'll attach reconciled table and recommended customer adjustments once done.

maya_cs: thanks team. Closing live pager once reconciliation confirms zero net customer impact.

incident-bot: Thread closed for live mitigation at 1777774640 (mitigation applied, follow-ups assigned).
